question.text: A call option has strike price Rs 1,170 and current underlying futures is Rs 1,280. Option premium is Rs 200. What is the time value?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the workbook example: Intrinsic Value = 1,280 - 1,170 = Rs 110, and Time Value = Premium - Intrinsic Value = 200 - 110 = Rs 90. The Trap: Rs 110 is intrinsic value, not time value. Rs 200 is the total premium. Rs 0 would only apply if the option had no time value left at all. Note: The Rs 90 is the current time value; per the workbook, time value tends to fall toward zero by expiry if other factors remain constant, while intrinsic value need not stay unchanged.
